title.zh: Comer presses Crypto.com, Hyperliquid and PredictIt on identity checks and suspicious trades

current_state.zh: House Oversight Chairman James Comer broadened his investigation into Crypto.com, Hyperliquid and PredictIt, requesting records on identity verification, trades by employees and government insiders, and suspicious activity referrals.
